title: Delete case 1: a red sibling
notes: Deleting the black leaf 80 leaves a doubly black NIL whose sibling, 50, is red. Case 1 swaps the colors of 50 and 70 and rotates right at 70. x now has a black sibling, 60, with black children: case 2 moves the extra black up to 70, which is red, so it just turns black.
